record: AISEF V2 — CYCLE-2 CORRIGENDUM 1 TO THE QP-2.7 / QP-2.8 RECORDS: THE LOWER-RUNG BINDING
kind: append-only corrigendum; the corrected records are not rewritten
what_they_should_say: closure-evidence/v2/cycle2/Q0-Q3-R3/SUMMARY.json (the GREEN QP-2.6 attempt on candidate 37dc0dc) in place of closure-evidence/v2/cycle2/Q0-Q3-R2/SUMMARY.json
cause: validation/qualification/q4_aggregate.py P7_EVIDENCE was set to the R2 summary when the prepared LANE-Q harness was rebased onto the R2 candidate, and was not moved to R3 when R2 failed; q5.py reads the same constant. Neither rung checks the verdict of the summary it binds.
impact: the binding is wrong; the measurements are not affected: both records name the R3 candidate 37dc0dc as their semantic candidate and its kernel tree 37bf6457 (the same tree R2's candidate carried), and what Q4 and Q5 consume — the kernel, reference, generator and harness digests (Q4) and the one identity over kernel, corpus and harness (Q5) — does not include the lower-rung summary. QP-2.6 on that candidate is GREEN (R3).
remedy: the final integration candidate's fresh Q4 and Q5 (closure-evidence/v2/cycle2/Q4-FINAL, Q5-FINAL) bind the R4 summary; q4_aggregate.P7_EVIDENCE names it
